programs.title: Cuttputlli
programs.desc: Arjan's investigation into schoolgirl murders and his pursuit of a suspected serial killer leads to a tragic incident involving his niece, resulting in dire consequences. Akshay Kumar, Rakul Preet Singh, Sargun Mehta, Chandrachur Singh, Hrishitaa Bhatt, Ranjit Tiwari, Aseem Arrora.

programs.desc: A beautiful yet complicated love blossoms between a spontaneous young man and a girl of strong values and pure intentions. As emotions intensify, their relationship becomes entangled in betrayal, desire, and heartbreak. Hania Aamir, Bilal Abbas Khan.
